patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts with large, often off-center, imagery and text blocks, creating dynamic visual balance and preventing a rigid grid feel.
Bold, condensed sans-serif headings in black or white provide strong hierarchy, contrasted with a lighter weight, more open sans-serif for readable body text.
A high-contrast, vibrant palette of dark green, bright lime yellow, and cream is used in large, distinct color blocks for section backgrounds and prominent accents.

The site features a dynamic sticky header that transforms on scroll: an initial minimal top bar disappears, and a more prominent header with the logo, main navigation, and primary CTAs slides into view.
Sections are clearly delineated by full-width background color changes, often featuring large, illustrative graphics or photography that break out of typical content bounds.

technique_notes: The header transforms on scroll: an initial minimalist top bar disappears, and a more substantial sticky header slides into view, featuring the site logo, primary navigation, and key call-to-action buttons.
Sections utilize distinct, full-bleed background colors (cream, dark green, bright yellow) to create clear visual separation and guide the user down the page.

Playful, hand-drawn style illustrations (tennis balls, rackets, 'attention' banner) are integrated as large, decorative elements that often overlap section boundaries or text blocks, adding character and visual interest.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, and often condensed sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong impact, while body text is a clear, readable sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card-like elements, with some organic, irregular shapes for decorative banners and illustrations.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; sections feature generous vertical padding, and content within sections maintains comfortable spacing for readability and visual breathing room.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a vibrant, almost neon, color palette combined with playful, hand-drawn illustrations and a dynamic sticky header creates an energetic and unique brand identity. The integration of these graphic elements, like the 'ATTENTION' banner and scattered tennis balls, feels organic and adds a memorable, youthful charm.
